preview.footnote: Banner · Frame · Nameplate · Sticker · Badges · Colours — all yours
preview.fillHint: Badges, roles and activity come from the server you are on.

personalize.messageStyleHint: Bubbles shows every message in a rounded card; Flat is one continuous river.
personalize.compactModeHint: Hides avatars and tightens the spacing.
personalize.alwaysShowActionsHint: Shows them on every message, not just on hover.
personalize.chatBackgroundHint: Keeps your last {{max}}, so switching back never means picking the file again.
personalize.focusHint: Click or drag the part that matters. A column narrower or shorter than the picture crops the rest away, and it keeps this point.
personalize.backgroundChoose: Choose an image or video — shown blurred behind chat
personalize.serverListHint: The rail keeps every server in view; the title bar keeps the window taller. With neither up there, it names the server you are on instead.
personalize.designHint: Nebula is the default. Standard is the older interface and still has the broadest feature coverage. Aurora is deprecated and will be removed in the next release - do not start using it.
personalize.designPinned: Pinned to "{{design}}" by the development URL override.
personalize.videoNotStored: That video could not be stored.
personalize.videoUnplayable: This system cannot play that video.
personalize.videoNotice: {{reason}} The still frame will show instead.
personalize.bakeFailed: That clip could not be optimized ({{reason}}). It will still play, but costs noticeably more while it is on screen.
personalize.channelViewerSubstituted: This profile has Standard's "{{stored}}" saved. Nebula has no collapsing folders, so it draws "{{shown}}".
personalize.bakingVideo: Optimizing video - {{percent}}% (the live preview shows meanwhile)
personalize.colorModeHint: Every theme is drawn in both a light and a dark scheme. This chooses which one the window wears.

gate.title: Voice gate
gate.modeAutoHint: Speak ~5 s; threshold, hysteresis and hold tune themselves.
gate.modeManualHint: Drag Open and Close markers directly on the meter.
gate.enough: That's enough — stop when you like
gate.neededHint: Speak naturally for 5 seconds so the gate tunes itself to your mic.
gate.calibratedHint: Run it again if you change microphone, room or filters.
gate.belowThreshold: Below the threshold — nothing is being sent.
gate.startMeterHint: Start the meter to see where your voice sits against the markers.
gate.hold: Hold — how long the gate stays open after you stop
gate.explainerAfter: , so a pause between words does not cut you off.
gate.replayHint: Record up to {{seconds}} s through the same filters your listeners receive, then play it back.

voice.activationPttHint: Only while a key is held.
voice.hintNone: No processing — the microphone is sent as it is heard.
voice.hintRnnoise: Neural network trained on real speech — works well in most environments.
voice.hintDeepfilternet: State-of-the-art deep learning. Best quality, highest CPU cost.
voice.hintOmlsa: Modern classical estimator — very smooth suppression.
voice.hintSpectral: The lightest option, and the best on steady background noise.
voice.engineDown: The audio engine is not responding, so voice settings cannot be read or changed right now.
voice.voiceOnTitle: Stops capture and playback. Stays off across reconnects.
voice.voiceOffTitle: You are neither transmitting nor receiving while voice is off.
voice.exclusiveInputHint: Takes the device straight from the driver, locking other applications out of it.
voice.processingHint: What happens to your voice before it leaves your machine.
voice.transmissionHint: How your voice travels to the server.
voice.quality: Quality — higher bitrate means better audio, more bandwidth
voice.audioPerPacket: Audio per packet — smaller is lower latency, larger saves bandwidth
voice.forceTcpHint: Send audio over the TCP tunnel instead of UDP — for strict firewalls or NAT that blocks UDP.
voice.legacyBackendHint: Switch to the legacy cpal backend if the default rodio backend misbehaves. Takes effect on the next voice toggle.

profile.pageHint: Everything on one page — each row shows your current pick; Change opens just that section.
profile.cardStyleHint: Colours first: everything else on the card takes its ramp from them.
profile.coloursHint: The first three colours rake down the card, the fourth becomes its border and the fifth its accent — the send button, the volume bar and every link on it.
profile.frostedGlassHint: Frosted glass over the card background
profile.stickerHint: Hangs off the card's top-right corner, like the mock's.
profile.whatTheCardShowsHint: Anything switched off here is hidden on every card of you, everywhere.
profile.sectionShelvesHint: Your collection, one rail per tier
profile.sectionMutualHint: Servers you share with the viewer
profile.sectionRolesHint: The groups the server puts you in
profile.sectionActivityHint: What you are playing, or where you are

overlay.title: Game overlay
overlay.hint: A small card over your game showing who is talking and the last message. It is a separate window, not code inside the game.
overlay.alwaysWarning: A permanently visible overlay can cost you variable refresh rate
overlay.alwaysWarningPara: Anything drawn over a game forces Windows to compose the frame instead of handing it straight to the display. On machines where multi-plane overlay is off, that disables G-Sync and FreeSync while the card is on screen. Showing it only while someone is talking avoids that for the rest of the time.
overlay.lastMessageHint: The most recent message in your channel, under the roster.
overlay.hideFromCaptureHint: Keeps the overlay out of your own screen share, recordings and streams - which also means it cannot appear in a screenshot. Turn it off if you want viewers to see who is talking, or to capture the overlay yourself.
overlay.diagnosticsHint: What the detector makes of whatever is in the foreground right now, and why. Games are recognised from your installed games, from what Windows itself calls a game, and from what a program says it is - never by looking inside it.
overlay.diagnosticsOff: The detector only runs while the overlay is switched on.
overlay.verdictGame: A game - the overlay may show
overlay.verdictProbably: Might be a game - asking first
overlay.verdictCannotShow: A game in exclusive fullscreen - nothing can be drawn over it
overlay.askBody: This looks like it might be a game. The overlay is a separate window that never touches the program itself.
overlay.windowFailed: The overlay window could not be created: {{error}}
overlay.hiddenPageNotReady: waiting for the overlay to finish loading
overlay.hiddenExclusive: the game is in exclusive fullscreen, so nothing can be drawn over it
overlay.hiddenWaiting: nobody is talking and no message is recent
overlay.hiddenManual: you hid it with the shortcut
overlay.contentUnknown: Content: the page has not reported yet
overlay.contentFailed: Content: the page could not read its data
overlay.contentDisconnected: Content: nothing - not connected to a server
